title: priceRanges widget shows ranges with no result
body:
I've noticed that priceRanges widget is listing ranges that have no result. A working example can be found here: https://goo.gl/hpiQLL

And is it possible to display count for items?

comments.body:
Hi @vvo 
I am sorry but your solution is not better than priceRanges widget. 
For example;
There is an option for less than 50. This option is still being listed even there are no items less than 50 for current refinements.

Hi @tecmusti indeed this is a bug to me also. I created the relevant issue here: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/1135

If you feel like contributing this would be a very good opportunity, I linked the relevant code.
Thanks a lot @tecmusti for all the feedback and bug reports!
